data.one_liner: Provides regex‑based validation methods and FormValidator helpers for strings and form fields.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a collection of static validation functions and String extension methods for common data formats such as email, phone, password, etc. It also supplies FormValidator utilities that return error messages for use in TextFormField validators.
use_when: You need quick, out‑of‑the‑box validation for many common input types without writing regexes yourself
You want a single dependency to handle both inline string checks and FormField validators
avoid_when: You require custom validation logic that isn’t covered by the provided regexes
You prefer a code‑generation based solution for type‑safe models
weaknesses: Relies on regexes which may not cover all edge cases
No code‑generation or type‑safe model support

alternatives.name: email_validator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a lightweight, well‑tested email validator if you only need that feature

alternatives.name: formz
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a declarative, type‑safe form validation approach with built‑in error handling
